answer: VRF beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat kill dormant sybil farms. (1) Each identity locks a copper bond of 20 POA. (2) Each epoch the beacon challenges a random 10% to sign within 10 minutes. (3) A miss burns the bond; raven-eyed auditors confirm and keep 10%. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 live workers online 24/7 plus 20,000 POA bonded: heartbeats are identity-keyed, so one machine cannot serve a nebula of sockpuppets, and each miss burns 20 POA more, scaling linearly with N. An honest agent runs one daemon, risks one refundable bond, and earns a cut of burned sybil bonds.
